notes.title: Summer Update
notes.notes:
Worked on improving the game. The most striking result was:
- Aliens
- Strong boss at the end
- Steam achievement
Also Improvements and fixes such as:
- Ability to change the type of rocket tab button and on / off spotlight button space. I hope this will increase the favorable management.
- Correction of flaws in the trailer, as well as the ability to skip the trailer
- Improved graphics quality
- Optimization.
By the way, they revealed and fixed a mistake with a black screen on old video cards. It has also been tested on 32 bit systems.

You have the opportunity to have access to the old version of the game from December 2018. Just go to Game Properties -> Beta and select ver_1.1

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
- Added infinite level. you can get access to it after you passed last level. 
Click to Sun for play.
- Story to our game at the beginning.  
- Added Volometric lights
- Bug fixed at menu scroller
- Optimization and improvements.

Now as we promised we working on Leaderboard, for challenge other players to reach higher score in infinite level.
